lines.label: Configuration introduction
lines.text: I know you must be confused, but don't worry. I will help you. My name is Happy, and I'm an experimental AI installed in your brain. Your body was nearly destroyed from the last mission, but I helped you to regain the control over your body. You'll be able to do things that used to be impossible for humans. Please take a moment to inspect your new body's configuration page, and click on Add Rule.

lines.label: Configuration farewell
lines.text: Unfortunately, I don't have time to explain the system to you because I need to finish the Alpha Feasibility Pitch right now. Good luck figuring out the body configuration system. Bye.

lines.label: Visit page 2
lines.text: I'm glad that you made it here.

lines.label: Visit page 3
lines.text: The thing is, you won! Congrats!

lines.label: Visit page 4
lines.text: Turns out we didn't have time to present a final boss fight at the moment.

lines.label: Visit page 5
lines.text: But... If you enjoyed the game.

lines.label: Visit page 7
lines.text: Do you want to enter the bonus wave?
